latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of pywayne-cv-apriltag-detector.
- Detects AprilTag fiducial markers in images for camera calibration and pose estimation.
- Supports image input as file paths or numpy arrays.
- Automatically installs the apriltag_detection library if needed via gettool.
- Provides methods to draw detected tag corners and IDs on images.
- Returns detection results including tag ID, hamming distance, center coordinates, and corners.
